children.text: 1 tablespoon white sugar, or to taste
1 pinch ground cinnamon, or to taste

Blend blueberries, yogurt, orange juice, sugar, vanilla extract and cinnamon together in a blender on low speed for 30 seconds, then increase speed to high and blend until smooth, about 2 minutes. Add ice and blend on high until smooth, about 1 minute more.
See the number of servings per recipe!
